text: Tough guy huh? He leaned on the bar, leather jacket shining like trouble itself. I thought he was gonna start a fight but he just asked if I liked dogs.
Dreams in my pocket, goals in my name. Life’s a test, I don’t study, I play, Turn the pain to a beat, let the rhythm slay.
Flick of a lighter, and the night starts to swing, Smoke curls slow while the trumpet takes wing, Fire in my fingers, and the shadows sing.
Chrome dreams rollin’ under city lights, Mercedes purrs soft through velvet nights, Money can’t buy soul but it sure rides nice.
So today, I’m not fetching, I’m not rolling over. I’m just gonna lie here, stare into the void, and vibe.
